bioconda.name: adtoolbox
bioconda.summary: Modeling and optimization of anaerobic digestion, from sequencing reads to ADM1/e-ADM simulation
bioconda.description:
ADToolbox turns metagenomics evidence into model-ready anaerobic digestion
simulations. It maps 16S amplicon data through GTDB and a curated
enzyme-to-reaction database, or profiles shotgun reads directly, to produce
the microbial COD allocation an extended ADM (e-ADM) model needs -- then
simulates, visualizes, and calibrates the model against experimental data.
